python3 -c '
# Triangulate Cabinet 1 from obs 95 and 96:
import cv2, numpy as np

# Poses:
# obs 94: pose (-0.3358, 3.9812), theta = 60 deg
# obs 95: turn -30 -> theta = 30 deg, move 0.5 ->
#   X = -0.3358 + 0.5 * sin(30 deg) = -0.0858
#   Y = 3.9812 + 0.5 * cos(30 deg) = 4.4142
# obs 96: move 0.5 along 30 deg ->
#   X = -0.0858 + 0.2500 = 0.1642
#   Y = 4.4142 + 0.4330 = 4.8472

img95 = cv2.imread("/work/observations/obs_0095.png")
img96 = cv2.imread("/work/observations/obs_0096.png")

mask95 = (img95[:,:,2] > 180) & (img95[:,:,2] < 230) & (img95[:,:,1] > 150) & (img95[:,:,1] < 200) & (img95[:,:,0] > 115) & (img95[:,:,0] < 165)
mask96 = (img96[:,:,2] > 180) & (img96[:,:,2] < 230) & (img96[:,:,1] > 150) & (img96[:,:,1] < 200) & (img96[:,:,0] > 115) & (img96[:,:,0] < 165)

ys95, xs95 = np.where(mask95[:, :450])
ys96, xs96 = np.where(mask96[:, :450])

w95 = xs95.max() - xs95.min() + 1
w96 = xs96.max() - xs96.min() + 1

print(f"Cabinet doors obs 95: x=[{xs95.min()}, {xs95.max()}], width={w95}, bottom_y={ys95.max()}, center_x={xs95.mean():.1f}")
print(f"Cabinet doors obs 96: x=[{xs96.min()}, {xs96.max()}], width={w96}, bottom_y={ys96.max()}, center_x={xs96.mean():.1f}")

d96 = 0.5 / (float(w96) / float(w95) - 1.0)
print(f"Parallax depth d95 = {d96 + 0.5:.4f} m, d96 = {d96:.4f} m")

# Compute world position from obs 96:
theta_rad = np.deg2rad(30.0)
Xc96 = (xs96.mean() - 255.5) / 256.0 * d96
X_w = 0.1642 + d96 * np.sin(theta_rad) + Xc96 * np.cos(theta_rad)
Y_w = 4.8472 + d96 * np.cos(theta_rad) - Xc96 * np.sin(theta_rad)
print(f"Cabinet position from obs 96: X = {X_w:.4f}, Y = {Y_w:.4f}")
'
